LESSON: VISUAL PROGRAMMING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Communication in Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 2.2: Visual Programming

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Visual Programming. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Visual Programming
2. Practise Visual Programming at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Visual Programming

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Visual Programming
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Visual Programming. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Visual Programming at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Visual Programming at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Visual Programming
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Visual Programming. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Visual Programming using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Visual Programming in the examples.
2. Explain Visual Programming to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Visual Programming.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Visual Programming using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Visual Programming important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Visual Programming
2. Practise Visual Programming at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Visual Programming

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
